expectedRoot.case_ids: List[str], literal ordered case_ids from SAFE inputs
expectedRoot.observations: List[CompletePositiveMETAObservation], same literal case order; no fields dropped

CompletePositiveMETAObservation.encoded_lanes: List[int], entire exact header/body in production Writer order
CompletePositiveMETAObservation.decoded_metadata: Entire C6HostMetadata byte-projection record with all identity/bounds/layout/run_id fields/options/digests/RunInt/native kinds/order; exact SAFE-BYTE-WIRE metadata type
CompletePositiveMETAObservation.blob_spans: List[BlobSpan], every Writer blob call in encoding order, including all emptytext and selectedemptydigest calls; no span for absent optional/digest content
CompletePositiveMETAObservation.final_blob_bytes: int, cumulative all text+opaque digest payload bytes, prefixes excluded
CompletePositiveMETAObservation.final_width_entries: int, complete cumulative number of entries in present index/counter/record width lists
CompletePositiveMETAObservation.final_cursor: int, onepastlast consumed META lane; equals complete encoded_lanes length on this positive domain

BlobSpan.kind: Text or OpaqueDigestBytes, plain enum string
BlobSpan.path: Ordered List[{Field:str}|{Index:int}], complete source byte-wire field location
BlobSpan.length_lane: int, absolute zero-based META-local byte-length prefix lane
BlobSpan.bytes_end: int, exclusive payload endpoint, equals bytes_start when empty
BlobSpan.bytes: List[int], full exact raw payload bytes

pathConvention.pair: Use Field(first) or Field(second) under the complete metadata source field path.
pathConvention.identity: Admission base[Field(identity)]; run base[Field(run_id),Field(identity)]. Within either identity use actual field names.
pathConvention.selectedDigest: For each digest field path: Text format paths append Field(format),Field(first/second); OpaqueDigestBytes path appends Field(bytes). Do NOT add an artificial Selected path step.
pathConvention.optionPair: Use actual option field path then first/second; no artificial Some step.
pathConvention.layout: Base[Field(layout)]; version/field_id/scalar_layout_id paths append actual field name then first/second.
pathConvention.widthName: [Field(layout),Field(widths),Field(listName),Index(i),Field(name)] where listName index_widths/counter_widths/record_widths; no artificial Some step.

semantics: Spans/finalcursor/finalcounters are a named mathematical projection of successful private Writer/Reader state, not extra public Rust outputs/getters, actual captured JSON or production runtime event/charge records.
positiveEquality: A later whole-list predicate must compare every sixfield observation to independently prefrozen complete literal data. Roundtrip/spans/counter laws may be additional conjuncts, never replacement subsets.
directedDesign: Complete three-case observations plus exact decode(encode(metadata)) equality on fullbyteprojection.
Unselected vs selected-empty digest stays distinct even though raw payload bytes empty; None vs Some(emptywidthrecord/emptypair) stays distinct.
Full admission/run identities and both bounds records remain distinct; no copying admission identity into run identity or layout bounds into admission.
NativeNegative/Nat0/NatMAX/NatAbove tags/padding preserved in both run-input positions across cohort; last3 bounds rawu128 and widths u32MAX transported exactly.
futureTypedTransport: QNT/K-specific declaration carrier/export schema is intentionally not invented here; after independent original JSON prefreeze, freeze exact declaration-only target types/interface before additive typed transport. No model or expected data authored by source lane.
